facts.summary: Phase 2b missed primary endpoint versus placebo · Phase 2 · ALTO-100 in major depressive disorder · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the Phase 2b study of ALTO-100 in patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) did not meet its primary endpoint, assessed by a change from baseline in Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS), compared to placebo.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The biomarker-defined MDD patient group treated with ALTO-100 did not demonstrate a statistically significant improvement in depressive symptoms compared to placebo.
evidence.safety: ALTO-100 continued to demonstrate a favorable safety and tolerability profile, with no new safety signals observed in this study as compared to the previously completed clinical trials of ALTO-100.
